welcomeBody: Pick a route. Collect a stamp at each stop.

crowdProvenance: Pilot sample schedule · illustrative, not live data
mapLoadError: The Kyoto map could not load. You can still browse the stored walks.
mapSearchPlaceholder: Where to? e.g. Yasaka, river, 10 min
mapSampleLocationLabel: Sample map point, not your GPS location
mapDemoMarkerLabel: Simulated Kyoto location, not your GPS position
locationStatusOff: No location selected. Choose GPS or Demo Mode.
locationStatusRequesting: Waiting for browser location permission and a fix…
locationStatusLowAccuracy: Live GPS is imprecise (±{accuracy} m). Your position may be off.
locationStatusLowAccuracyOutside: Live GPS is imprecise (±{accuracy} m) and reports a position outside Kyoto.
locationStatusOutsideKyoto: Outside Kyoto. Your actual location is shown (±{accuracy} m).
locationStatusDenied: Location permission denied. Retry or use Demo Mode.
locationStatusTimeout: Location timed out. Retry or use Demo Mode.
locationStatusUnavailable: Location unavailable. Check browser support and HTTPS.
locationStatusPaused: GPS stopped outside Explore. Tap Use My Location to resume.
routesMapChecked: These walks follow map-checked pedestrian ways. Check current signs and conditions before walking.
routesSearchFallback: No verified walk matches every part of that request. These are the available map-checked walks; check their details before choosing.
routesEmpty: No validated walk matches this search or theme yet.
routesCommunityNotConsulted: Community representatives have not reviewed this place entry. Respect current signs and local access rules.
gameStopHint: Keep the stamps and points already earned and end this walk?
gameGpsHint: Check-in opens within {radius} m, with a fresh GPS fix accurate to ±{accuracy} m.
receiptStandard: Why: base {base} pts at the standard rate
surgeWhy: Walking between {start}:00 and {end}:00 keeps you off the busiest morning buses, leaving room for residents getting to work and school.
questsEmptyAvailable: Every walk is in progress or complete.
questsEmptyActive: No walk in progress. Start one from Available.
questsEmptyCompleted: Finish a walk to see it here.
goshuinBody: One seal per stop, kept on this device.
walletDisclosure: Demo vouchers from fictional shops. Points have no cash value and nothing here is accepted at a real store.
walletEmptyMine: Unlock a voucher with your points to see it here.
walletNoActivity: Check in on a walk to start earning points.
redeemDemoStrip: Demo only · not accepted at any shop
redeemStaffHoldJa: 店員さま：長押しで確認
locationSettingsHint: Turning Demo Mode off keeps GPS off. Recenter opens Explore; paused live GPS needs a new Use My Location tap.
gameResetBody: Clear all walks, stamps, points and vouchers on this browser? Your nickname and language will be kept.
aboutBody: Explore three map-checked Kyoto walks with optional GPS or simulated movement. Progress is saved in this browser. Routes await field review. Crowd levels and the off-peak schedule are samples, and all points, shops and vouchers are fictional.
